working_title: When Better Search Teaches Less: Serving-Induced Observation Kernels in Self-Evolving Agents
scientific_question: When a self-evolving agent generates a best-of-K search pool, does coupling the acting selector to winner-only learning censor reusable failed evidence and make the acting-optimal trajectory learning-suboptimal?

story.acting_projection: Serve the highest-verifier trajectory from the generated pool.
story.learning_projection: Choose which content-addressed evidence from that same pool reaches the persistent updater.
story.central_claim: On precommitted rescue events, winner-only serving removes exactly the failed witness that rollout-0 would have exposed; if that witness has positive reusable diagnostic value, changing only the learning projection changes future frozen skill.
story.minimal_method: Act from the winner; on a frozen rescue event learn from the precommitted rejected witness, otherwise learn from the winner.
nonclaims: failures are newly discovered to be useful
success/failure contrast or first divergence is novel
the iid reference curve is an empirical law
Rejected-Witness is necessarily more complex than existing contrastive skill methods

current_evidence.identity: A_K-A_1 = V_pre(K)-V_winner(K) = Gamma_K holds exactly on the frozen pools

hypotheses.H0_support: The frozen 54-task calibration lane contains at least six precommitted rescue tasks spanning at least three mutually exclusive failure families.
hypotheses.H1_causal: Under identical initial skill, exact K=8 pool, acting winner, updater, budget, and held-out probes, Rejected-Witness yields higher future frozen K=1 success than Winner-only.
hypotheses.H1_controls: The primary gain is not reproduced by duplicated-winner token matching or deterministic random-nonwinner diversity; SkillCAT-style contrast determines whether the minimal witness is sufficient or a richer contrast is needed.
hypotheses.H2_public: The simplest mechanism-qualified projection improves average frozen K=1 success over Winner-only on public benchmarks across qualified executor backbones.
hypotheses.H3_prediction: Pre-outcome family-level censoring mass times cloned diagnostic value predicts held-out effect sign, family rank, K ordering, and preregistered null cells.
hypotheses.H4_longitudinal: High-K online acting can rise while Winner-only frozen skill lags; a history-preserving learning projection reduces that divergence over multiple rounds.
hypotheses.H5_topology: At matched actor-call budget, learning projection explains the persistent-skill difference more directly than parallel versus sequential search topology.

model_plan.executor_target: >=4 qualified models and >=2 model families for the public core matrix
model_plan.updater_robustness: One second qualified updater only after E1 GO; no full actor x updater cross-product.

model_pilot.primary_run: K=1 on all 12 fixed development tasks
model_pilot.search_smoke: K=4 nested prefixes on four predeclared tasks

promotion_checks.k1_headroom_rule: Neither all-zero nor all-one on the 12 fixed tasks; used only to reject structurally uninformative capability regimes, never to select larger R17 gain.
promotion_checks.resume_replay_check: Interrupt one predeclared technical smoke unit and verify missing-unit-only resume without repeating completed provider calls.

public_core_methods: Final simplest R17 method; replace with Precommitted or SkillCAT-style if identical to Rejected-Witness

baseline_pilot.gate: Implementation fidelity, input-information parity, actor/update budget accounting, valid artifacts, common verifier, checkpoint/resume, and source-label accuracy. No method-effect threshold is allowed.

S0_E0_full_support.purpose: Complete the already frozen support qualification before any updater intervention.
S0_E0_full_support.go: All integrity checks pass and the 54-task combined result meets both support thresholds.
S0_E0_full_support.stop: Protocol failure or insufficient frozen rescue support. Do not open public benchmarks or alter taxonomy to rescue the mechanism on this substrate.
S0_E0_full_support.execution: Run only missing units from the 42-task extension; never rerun the completed 12 tasks.

E1_causal_identification.entry: S0 GO plus a new content-addressed full contract and authorization.
E1_causal_identification.actor: Frozen DeepSeek V4-Pro executor in the primary identification run
E1_causal_identification.updater: Pinned MindMemOS SkillEvolver, DeepSeek V4-Pro, exact config and initial skill SHA
E1_causal_identification.scientific_unit: One independently evolved eight-task cloned stream-state
E1_causal_identification.go: Provenance passes; mean RW-Winner > 0; one-sided p <= 0.05; 95% CI lower > 0; duplicated winner does not reproduce the gain.
downgrade: Random Nonwinner matches RW => generic diversity explanation
SkillCAT-style dominates => retain prior contrast method and narrow R17 to mechanism
RW is sufficient => delete any more complex CADP label
E1_causal_identification.stop: No reproducible directional difference under exact same-pool cloned states, duplicated-winner equivalence, post-outcome witness selection, or any cloned invariant failure.

preoutcome_split_v1.rule: Deterministic content-hash split, stratified only by released metadata/instruction type; exact IDs frozen before any candidate-model outcome.

one_step_public_design.pool_sharing: All projection arms for a model/stream use the exact same initial skill, pool, and acting winner.
one_step_public_design.rationale: Preserves the central one-step causal object on a public benchmark; repeated path-dependent evolution is reserved for E4.

secondary_benchmark.name: SkillEvolBench
secondary_benchmark.design: Use the official 30 environment-by-skill-family cells; T1-T3 are acquisition and T4-T6 frozen K=1 evaluation. Generate nested K pools for acquisition, keep pools common across projection arms, and use the native updater only after adapter Pilot.
secondary_benchmark.adapter_gate: Official validators, harness identity, tool artifacts, acquisition/evaluation separation, and missing-unit resume must pass before any full run.

E2_public_effectiveness.methods: Four core methods on all models; extended baseline matrix on one weak/common and one strong representative executor.

statistics.primary_unit_verified: 20 paired stream-state blocks; compute each block's mean over its ten test tasks before inference
statistics.ci: Paired hierarchical bootstrap over stream blocks, stratified by model; report model-specific 95% CIs and paired Delta versus Winner-only
statistics.cross_model: Report descriptive mean, range, and model-stratified bootstrap; do not treat four models as a large-n significance test
statistics.replication: One primary frozen partition for all four models; two additional provider/order replications on two representative models, clustered rather than counted as independent tasks.

E2_public_effectiveness.go: The qualified simplest method has positive paired gain over Winner-only on the primary public benchmark, no material safe/valid-task regression, and directionally consistent support on the secondary benchmark or a predeclared bounded transport statement.
E2_public_effectiveness.hold: Primary positive but model/benchmark heterogeneity prevents a general claim; report the bounded regime without adding a rescue benchmark.
E2_public_effectiveness.stop: Primary public transport is null/negative under the frozen design; do not open SpreadsheetBench 2 as rescue.

E3_prospective_prediction.entry: E1 GO; calibration and confirmatory IDs frozen before confirmatory outcomes are opened.
E3_prospective_prediction.calibration: Estimate c_z(K), delta_z, and Lambda_K only from development/calibration cloned units.
E3_prospective_prediction.confirmatory_design_v1: Use a disjoint controlled-suite reserve with six mutually exclusive families and nested K={1,2,4,8}; exact stream/cell counts finalized in V3 after outcome-blind support simulation, never after effect results.
E3_prospective_prediction.go: Predeclared sign and rank predictions pass their frozen thresholds and calibration is not contradicted by held-out cells.
E3_prospective_prediction.stop: Prediction only fits observed/calibration data or fails sign/rank/null-cell tests; delete predictive-theory claim regardless of public method gain.

E4_multi_round.entry: E1 and E2 GO; separate full contract.
E4_multi_round.pilot: Two rounds on two fixed development streams; runtime and state/checkpoint qualification only.
E4_multi_round.statistics: Paired stream-level trajectories with simultaneous confidence bands; report first-round causal effect separately from later path-dependent divergence.
E4_multi_round.go: Winner-only shows a reproducible online/frozen divergence and the history-preserving projection reduces it without current-acting degradation.
E4_multi_round.stop: No longitudinal divergence or repair after the one-step mechanism qualified; do not rewrite the one-step result as a longitudinal claim.

factor_A: sequential refinement with matched eight actor calls
topology_factorial.pilot: Two streams, one update, outcome-blind runtime qualification
topology_factorial.full_v1: Eight streams per cell, common K=1 probes

E5_topology_external_validation.optional_benchmark: SpreadsheetBench 2 only after Verified-400 GO and a pre-outcome subset/evaluator contract; visualization remains secondary because it changes the evaluator substrate.
E5_topology_external_validation.purpose: Separate learning projection from compute amount/topology; no universal claim that parallel search is harmful.

checkpoint_contract.timeout_rule: After MCP 502, message timeout, or SSH disconnect, inspect process, lock, completed manifest, checkpoint, and summary before any launch; duplicate launch is forbidden.
